entities.summary: Francis George "Franc" Roddam is an English film director, businessman, screenwriter, television producer and publisher, best known as the creator of Auf Wiedersehen, Pet and Masterchef and as the director of Quadrophenia (1979). He is a graduate of the London Film School. Franc Roddam was a performers & entertainers from Norton (b. 1946-04-29, Norton). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
